dispute.claim_text: He was on his phone from the moment I got in. Chatting, scrolling, driving slowly so he could keep scrolling. He braked hard twice and drifted lanes. Then he missed the expressway split and we ended up on the other side of the island. Forty minutes became ninety. I was terrified and I'm not exaggerating.

counterparty_statement.text: I was checking the navigation on my phone, that's not 'playing'. The KPE split is confusing, I missed it once. I don't think the extra distance was that much.
